## Do not edit this folder

This is the replication record for Baqaee–Farhi (2019), Econometrica. It is
retained for reference and for verification methodology; it is not part of
the active closure pipeline.

Known open items at freeze (see `registry/freeze.toml`): reallocation Monte
Carlo gap vs MATLAB (~14% in the mean), full 50k-draw and R6 runs still to
execute, the reference-only Jacobian bug, and the oil-shock headline
disagreement between `REPLICATION_ASSESSMENT.md` (1.28×) and
`REPLICATION_REPORT.md` (1.92×).

Sources: `REPLICATION_REPORT.md`, `REPLICATION_ASSESSMENT.md`,
`REPLICATION_WORKPLAN.md`.
